issue.title: listWidgets: sort numbers inside names as numbers
issue.body:
## Problem

`listWidgets` compares names as plain text, so a list with numbers in the names comes out in a surprising order:

```js
listWidgets([{ name: 'widget10' }, { name: 'widget2' }, { name: 'widget1' }]).map((w) => w.name);
// ['widget1', 'widget10', 'widget2']
```

## Proposal

Compare the numbers inside names as numbers, so the result is `['widget1', 'widget2', 'widget10']`. Names without numbers must sort as they do now, still ignoring case.

## Acceptance

- A test for the example above.
- The existing tests still pass.
